description: This file is a PHP source script for rendering the 'Detail View' of a FAQ module in a CRM system, specifically part of the Vtiger CRM system. It handles retrieving FAQ data, setting up Smarty template variables, and controlling permissions and related lists for the detail view.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: A class representing the CRM entity, used to retrieve the entity instance and data.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: A Smarty template engine extension used to render the CRM detail view template.

classes.name: PerformancePrefs
classes.description: A utility class to retrieve performance configuration preferences.

classes.name: RelatedListViewSession
classes.description: A class managing related list session data for navigation between related records.

methods.name: retrieve_entity_info
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information of an entity based on record ID.

methods.name: getFAQComments
methods.description: Returns comments related to the FAQ record.

methods.name: isPermitted
methods.description: Checks user permissions for specific actions on a record.

methods.name: Button_Check
methods.description: Checks for button permissions or configurations, specific to the module.

methods.name: getRelatedLists
methods.description: Retrieves related list data for the current module.

methods.name: getModuleSequenceField
methods.description: Gets the sequence number field for the module, if any.

methods.name: markAsViewed
methods.description: Marks the current record as viewed by the current user.
